name: How can I prevent storm drain blockages?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent storm drain blockages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing storm drain blockages involves regular maintenance and being mindful of what enters your drains. Regularly clean leaves, debris, and sediment from grates and downspout connections. Avoid pouring grease, chemicals, or disposing of solid waste down any drains connected to your storm system. Consider installing gutter guards to minimize leaf entry into downspouts. Proactive steps like these can significantly reduce the likelihood of costly repairs, a practice we encourage for all our customers in Southern Highlands and The Lakes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent blockages by regularly cleaning grates, avoiding improper disposal, and using gutter guards. Proactive maintenance reduces repair needs.
